about_body: Lavion Core Hub was built for training that feels considered — every rig, every class, every coach exists to move one number: yours.
prog1_body: Barbell-first programming built around the big lifts, coached in small blocks so your bar path actually gets watched.
prog2_body: Interval and engine work on a rotating floor circuit, built for people training for a sport, a season, or a number on a watch.
prog3_body: Mobility sessions, cold immersion, and coached stretch work — the part of training people skip until it costs them.

wp_demo_badge: Sample programming — actual plans are adjusted by your coach
wp_title: What a week actually looks like.
wp_sub: Every member gets a program adjusted to their level in the first assessment. These are representative weekly structures for each track, not a substitute for coach-led programming.
wp_footnote: This is a representative structure, not your actual plan. Real programming is set individually after your first movement assessment and adjusted by your coach every few weeks based on progress.
nutr_demo_badge: General guidance — not personalized medical or dietary advice
nutr_sub: These are general starting-point examples, not prescriptions. Everyone's needs differ based on body size, activity level, health history, and goals — talk to a registered dietitian or your doctor before making significant changes to how you eat, especially if you have any medical conditions.
diet1_desc: A higher-protein, moderate-surplus approach commonly used to support strength and muscle gain — adjust portions to your own size and goals.
meal_d1_lunch: Rice, grilled chicken or paneer, vegetables
meal_d1_dinner: Sweet potato, fish or lentils, salad
diet2_desc: Balanced carbs to fuel interval work, with enough protein to support recovery between sessions.
meal_d2_dinner: Brown rice, tofu or chicken, greens
diet3_desc: A moderate, sustainable pattern for members training a few times a week without a specific performance goal.
meal_d3_dinner: Grilled protein of choice, roasted vegetables
nutr_footnote_b: *Calories and macros shown are general reference points only
nutr_footnote_rest: — based on averages for an active adult, not calculated for any individual. Actual needs vary widely by body size, sex, age, activity level, and goals. Lavion coaches can point members toward a registered dietitian for a plan tailored to them; this page is a starting reference, not a diet plan to follow as-is.
